plan.explanation: Face F1 is machined first on M2 to establish the datum. Pockets F2 and F5 follow. Through-hole F3 is drilled on M2. Threaded hole F4 is drilled then tapped (on M2 for drilling, M1 for tapping). Pocket F5 is machined after F1. Threaded hole F6 is drilled then tapped.
assumptions: Tooling sizes are assumed compatible with feature dimensions without collision analysis.
Setup times between operations are ignored.
uncertainties: Actual tool diameters for T1-T2 vs hole F3/F4/F6 diameters to determine if spot_drilling or direct drilling is preferred (drilling used per constraints).
